ItemID: NA; Title: SELTERM 25pcs 4 AWG 3/8" Stud Battery Lugs, Ring Terminals, Heavy Duty Copper Wire Lugs, Battery Cable Ends, 4 Guage Ring Terminal Connectors, UL Bare Copper Eyelets Electrical Battery Cable Lugs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My past wire connector purchase fits general repairs, but I have no current need for these specific cable and stud sizes.
ItemID: NA; Title: No. 6 x 1/2" Stainless Truss Head Phillips Wood Screw, (100 pc), 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Sheet Metal Screws, Type A Point, Plain Finish by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful hardware, but I would need a project requiring this exact screw size before buying a hundred.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mitutoyo 500-196-30 Advanced Onsite Sensor (AOS) Absolute Scale Digital Caliper, LCD & NEIKO 01407A Electronic Digital Caliper | 0 - 6 Inches | Stainless Steel Construction; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Precision measuring is not a clear need in my recent repair purchases, so I would skip this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ginsco 580 pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 6 Colors 11 Sizes Assorted Sleeving Tube Wrap Cable Wire Kit for DIY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This complements my wire connector assortment and would help insulate connections across several wire sizes.
ItemID: NA; Title: Super Glue 15187 , Clear- pack of 12; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives interest me, but twelve tubes exceed what I would choose without a specific repair in mind.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no identified fastening job needing half-inch washers, so this pack feels too specific right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: NEIKO 11107A 10 Pack Aluminum Oxide Flap Discs 4-1/2 for Angle Grinder, 60 Grit Flapper Wheel, Flat T27 Grinding Wheel 4.5 Inch Flap Disc, 7/8" Arbor Grinding Disc, Wood & Metal Sanding; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history does not establish an angle grinder or a current sanding project that would justify these discs.
ItemID: NA; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying hose clamps does not mean I need metal cutting supplies, and I have no matching task right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loctite Epoxy Five Minute Instant Mix, Two 0.47-Fluid Ounce Syringes (1715208); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The small quantity and quick mixing appeal for occasional repairs, consistent with my tape and vinyl cement purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It could suit a future repair, but I would choose the small quick-setting epoxy this time and wait for a specific need for this one.
